title: Etale descent of the reduced Cartier structure on a closed subset
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $Z\subseteq X$ be a closed subset, and let $D=Z_{\mathrm{red}}\hookrightarrow X$ be its reduced induced closed subscheme [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. For every etale morphism $v:W\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], the pullback closed subscheme $D\times_XW$ is the reduced induced closed subscheme on $v^{-1}(Z)$. If $\{v_i:W_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ is a jointly surjective etale covering, then $D$ is an effective Cartier divisor if and only if every $D\times_XW_i$ is an effective Cartier divisor. Here an effective Cartier divisor is a closed subscheme whose ideal is locally generated by a non-zero-divisor [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal, def-weil-closed-immersion]; the empty divisor is permitted.

mathlib_searches.query: A reduced closed subset of a locally noetherian scheme is an effective Cartier divisor if its inverse images on an etale cover are reduced effective Cartier divisors.
Effective Cartier divisors and reduced induced closed subschemes descend along etale covers.
The property that a closed immersion is a reduced effective Cartier divisor is local in the etale topology on its target.
